subject: Pilot budget confirmation, token targets, and credit top-up proposal
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@fastretail.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex@fastretail.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + ask: token volumes & target budget

Hi Priya / Alex —

Great meeting today — thanks for walking through the use case and the live demo. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I loop in procurement and ops: 

Summary (one-liner): FastRetail wants a customer-chat assistant + product recommender for mobile/web, real-time responses, and weekly rerank/embeddings jobs for recommendations.

Key actions for you:
- Can you confirm expected production token volumes (avg tokens per request, expected daily average and peak)? We need approximate daily/monthly totals to size the pilot.
- What is the budget range your team is comfortable with for the 30–60 day pilot? Any target $/1M tokens you’re trying to hit for procurement?
- Procurement timeline & contact (name/email) so we can prepare trial terms.

My proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) You share rough token volumes + procurement contact (this week)
2) We configure a pilot env, enable usage guardrails, and provide an initial credit top-up while onboarding
3) 2-week check-in to validate expected burn, then adjust configuration/pricing if needed

I’ve attached a very short usage template (usage-estimate-fastretail-20261128.csv) to make it quick to drop in numbers — feel free to forward that to procurement.

If you can send the numbers by tomorrow, I’ll draft a pilot credit recommendation and a short trial terms PDF for legal. Proposed check-in: Dec 12 to review metrics.

Thanks!
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: usage-estimate-fastretail-20261128.csv
From: Priya Shah <priya@fastretail.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex@fastretail.com>, FastRetail Procurement <procurement@fastretail.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + ask: token volumes & target budget

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the recap and the template. Filling in numbers below (high-level estimates from engineering + product):

Estimated usage (month 1 pilot):
- Active users (pilot): ~50k MAU (subset of web + mobile)
- Avg tokens per interaction (NLG): ~220 tokens (prompt + response)
- Peak concurrency: ~6% of MAU at peak windows
- Expected requests/day (avg): ~125k requests/day
- Estimated tokens/day (avg): ~27,500,000 tokens/day (~825,000,000 tokens/month) — note: includes system prompts + responses + metadata
- We will run embeddings rerank jobs once per day: ~15M embed tokens/day (token counting differs for embeddings but include for cost)

Budget and procurement:
- For the pilot we have a soft budget range of $10k–$30k total depending on unit pricing; procurement seeks a target price <= $25 per 1M tokens for generation workload.
- Procurement timeline: signed PO target by 2026-12-15. Procurement contact: Sofia Martinez (sofia.martinez@fastretail.com).

Two asks from our side:
1) A short-term credit/top-up while we validate numbers so we don’t hit hard rate limits during the first 2 weeks
2) Unit pricing guidance — if you can propose a pilot rate and any volume bands that would help.

I’ve cc’d procurement. Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,
Priya Shah
Head of Product — Personalization | FastRetail
priya@fastretail.com

Attachments: procurement-timeline-fastretail.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: FastRetail numbers — ask: credit top-up + pilot pricing recommendation

Karthik / Neha —

Forwarding Priya’s estimates. The key numbers that matter for cost modeling: ~27.5M gen tokens/day + 15M embed tokens/day — rough total ~42.5M tokens/day. Using a conservative multiplier for system prompts and retries, call it ~50M tokens/day for capacity planning. If those ballpark numbers hold, monthly pilot burn could be ~1.5B tokens (very large).

Quick calc for proposal pricing (generation + embeddings simplified for this ask):
- Target unit price that procurement wants: <= $25 / 1M tokens
- At $22 / 1M tokens, 1.5B tokens/month = 1500 * $22 = $33,000/mo (pilot overshoots FastRetail’s 10k–30k pilot budget)

Recommendation: offer a temporary credit top-up to cover the first 2 weeks of production traffic and propose a pilot rate of $22 / 1M tokens (pilot-only, expires on PO signing or end of 60 days). Suggested credit amount: $2,000–$5,000 depending on procurement comfort. Also propose usage guardrails (rate limiting + prefix caching + routing to cheaper variant for non-critical paths) to reduce burn.

Asks:
- Neha: can we approve an initial $2,000 credit top-up from the SDR/pilot credit pool?
- Karthik: does leadership sign off on offering $22/1M pilot rate and a $2k–$5k credit?

I’ll draft the short trial-terms PDF and a scoped MAP for procurement once I have approval. Tagging Marcus for billing ops steps.

Thanks,
Vanessa

--- Forwarded message attached below ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: FastRetail numbers — ask: credit top-up + pilot pricing recommendation

Vanessa —

Thanks for the summary and the math. Approve the following operationally: 
- Approve a one-time $2,000 pilot credit from the pilot credit pool to avoid early throttling (we want to keep the momentum).
- Approve offering a pilot unit price of $22 / 1M tokens for generation traffic (pilot-only, documented in the trial terms). Embeddings pricing to be billed at standard list rate but we will provide visibility.

Please include explicit usage guardrails in the trial (daily spend cap, per-minute rate limits, and a kill-switch for peak abnormal behavior). Marcus — can you prepare the bill-run notes and ensure credit application works from a billing perspective?

Vanessa: once you confirm with procurement, get Sofia’s PO contact and I’ll sign off on the short trial addendum.

Karthik
VP, Sales Operations

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Hi Priya / Alex / Sofia —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for looping procurement. Good news: we can approve a one-time $2,000 pilot credit to keep things moving, and sales ops has authorized a pilot rate of $22 / 1M tokens for generation traffic for the 60-day pilot (embeddings billed at list; we will monitor and recommend any optimization).

What we need from FastRetail to finalize:
- Please review and sign the attached short 1–page trial terms (trial-terms-redwood-v1.pdf) — it documents the $2k credit, pilot rate, and agreed usage guardrails (daily spend cap + rate limits).
- Procurement contact (Sofia Martinez) — can you share PO contact and expected PO date? You mentioned target PO by Dec 15 which is perfect.
- If the usage estimates in your CSV are final, drop the CSV back to me and we’ll pre-configure guardrails to avoid accidental blasts to production.

Next steps & timeline:
- Today: I’ll upload the trial terms and open the credit; Marcus will ensure the credit posts to your trial account.
- Dec 12: Check-in call to review actual burn and any configuration tweaks (30-min).
- Dec 15: Aim for PO. If PO arrives earlier we’ll convert to committed billing per the PO terms.

If you want to accelerate, happy to get legal/procurement on a short call this week.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
